commit.title: When loading autosave or crash files, use the correct original path
commit.message:
When loading autosave or crash files, use the correct original path

We store the original path as a URI, but we weren't converting back
from a URI to a local path again, so the URI was being treated as a
relative path and appended to the current folder.

Fixes https://gitlab.com/inkscape/inkscape/-/work_items/6134
